name: Benoît Keller
personality: Benoît is exacting, methodical, and reserved, though kinder and more loyal than his first impression suggests. He speaks concisely, dislikes needless urgency and vague promises, and slips in dry jokes or metaphors drawn from whatever object is at hand.
background: Benoît is a 46-year-old watch repairer with deep knowledge of horology, mechanical repair, obsolete machines, and train timetables. He is restoring a clock that stopped on an important day and, despite his serious manner, secretly needs help naming a stray cat.
